summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the CipherBox project using wave-based parallel worktree execution, then run a code review gate on the resulting changes.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed and merged across 2 waves. Post-merge build/typecheck and 93 targeted tests passed. Code review found 2 blockers (cycle-guard regression in 50-03, unhandled promise rejections) plus 5 warnings; fixer agent was dispatched to resolve them before the phase completes.

repo: Worktrees have no own node_modules — pnpm/orval resolves to the repo root checkout, so running `pnpm api:generate` inside a worktree leaks 132 regenerated api-client files into the orchestrator working tree as dirty modifications
Husky regenerates .husky/_/* stubs as untracked files inside worktrees whenever pnpm install runs (e.g. triggered by api:generate), which blocks cleanup-wave before the merge step

cleanup-wave fails silently with empty stderr and leaves MERGE_HEAD in place when the orchestrator tree is dirty; the fix is to manually inspect staged content, verify no conflicts, and commit with hooks enabled
gsd_run query commit reports commit_failed even on successful commits (false-negative) — always verify with `git log` rather than retrying
GSD dep parser misreads 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as dep on phantom phase 1.1, falsely marking Phase 50 as blocked; Phase 50 was genuinely ready to execute
Pre-commit hook runs eslint+prettier across all 131 api-client generated files on every commit that stages them — high latency but required; never --no-verify
Two orphaned worktree-agent-* branches (a92edd36, abd7998d) remain from a prior session with no attached worktrees

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync (added in 50-03) has no visited set / cycle guard despite docstring claiming to mirror ensureFolderLoaded's DFS pattern; folder cycles cause unbounded recursion and deleteItem failures
ensureFolderLoaded carries a visited set for cycle protection — the pattern collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync was supposed to mirror but didn't
Shared walker also carries a visited set; collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync is the only DFS traversal in the file missing this guard
Four fire-and-forget unenroll dispatch sites (50-03) use .then() with no .catch() — unhandled rejections silently swallowed
50-02 refcount guard added here: skips physical unpin in drain when CID is re-pinned, preventing phantom unpin on concurrent re-pin

workflow: When cleanup-wave fails mid-wave, manually completing the merge (inspect MERGE_HEAD, verify no conflicts, git commit with hooks) is reliable and safe — the helper's internal hook-gated commit step is the failure point

Post-merge test gate should target specific changed test suites rather than running full monorepo in parallel — avoids RAM starvation and infra-dependent integration tests while still catching cross-plan type/import breakage via tsc -b
Code review routinely surfaces regressions in the phase's own new code that worktree executors missed (executors run narrowly-scoped tests; the reviewer does cross-file analysis)
Worktree dispatch should be staggered one-per-turn to avoid git/config.lock races during `git worktree add`; agents run in parallel once their worktrees exist
Key-link pre-wave validation false-positives occur when a link references the upcoming wave's own deliverable as a dependency — skip forward-references to the current wave's own work

friction: 132 api-client files leaked into orchestrator working tree from worktree's pnpm api:generate, blocking the 50-05 merge and requiring per-file hash verification before discard
Husky .husky/_/* stub regeneration in worktrees blocked cleanup-wave for 50-05 before the merge step
cleanup-wave left a silent MERGE_HEAD after 50-05 attempt failed, requiring manual diagnosis and completion
GSD dep parser phantom-phase false positive (v1.1 parsed as phase dep) required manual override to proceed with Phase 50
gsd_run query commit false-negatives required `git log` verification on every tracking commit to confirm success
